c1_disposition.rationale: Existing Crossref v0.3 projects the citing Work's optional deposited reference rows; the new tool resolves a caller-selected cited DOI and compares supplied structured fields against that target Work. The scopes are complementary and no tool replaces all valuable uses of the other.

findings: The existing Crossref verifier returns a bounded source-deposited reference projection but does not resolve referenced DOIs.
The existing publication snapshot comparator operates on already-collected Crossref/OpenAlex title/year rows and does not fetch cited Works.
The single selected DOI provides a real end-to-end capability demonstration, not an accuracy or provider-quality benchmark.
Retain both Crossref tools as default-off complementary options; do not retire existing runtime code based on this one record.
uncertainties: General Crossref reference DOI resolution coverage and failure rate are unknown.
Metadata differences across source-deposited citations and target Work records may reflect abbreviation, version, update, or deposit choices; this tool does not adjudicate them.
Matched latency, cost, broad accuracy, and completeness comparisons were not conducted.
